title: How Many Days Does Spring Festival Last?
synopsis: Find out how the Spring Festival is celebrated!

fullText.simplified:
春节到底有几天？

    如果有人问你春节是什么，你大概会说春节是中国的传统新年。但是如果继续问你，春节是几月几号，一共有几天，恐怕你就很难回答了。
    春节是中国人的“新年”，是中国最重要的传统节日。人们为了庆祝新年，会举行很多活动，这些活动和活动带来的欢乐气氛会持续较长一段时间，中国人把这一段时间总称为“过年”。
    在现代中国，人们一般认为过年有七天，从除夕到农历一月六日。
    除夕是农历十二月三十日，是农历年的最后一天。这一天，人们要和家人在一起，大家一起包饺子、做年夜饭，一直等到晚上十二点，这是“守岁”。
    “守岁”后，第二天——农历一月一日到来，就是真正的春节了，是新年的第一天。从这一天开始，人们会去亲戚朋友家，一起聊天吃饭，给老人和孩子红包，这就是“拜年”。“拜年”活动会持续好些天。
    一月五日很特别，很多人会早起放鞭炮。人们认为这一天是穷神离开、金钱之神回来的日子，放鞭炮是为了迎接金钱之神。这种活动叫“破五”。
    一月七日，人们回到公司开始工作，新的一年真正开始了。
    对于学生和不着急出去工作的人来说，他们的春节要更长一些。因为一月七日之后还有一些传统的小活动，关于吃的、玩儿的，都让人兴奋。一直到过完一月十五日的元宵节，生活才回到老样子。对于老人来说，真正的春节是从十二月二十三日开始的，二月二日才结束。他们在除夕前打扫房间，等待孩子们回来过年。二月二日春天开始，孩子们回到公司和学校，他们的春节才真正结束。
    所以说，春节并不是只有一天。它到底有多少天，可能每个人的答案都不太一样。不过呢，不管答案是什么，都没有关系，因为开开心心过年才是最重要的呢！
fullText.traditional:
春節到底有幾天？

    如果有人問你春節是什麼，你大概會說春節是中國的傳統新年。但是如果繼續問你，春節是幾月幾號，一共有幾天，恐怕你就很難回答了。
    春節是中國人的“新年”，是中國最重要的傳統節日。人們為了慶祝新年，會舉行很多活動，這些活動和活動帶來的歡樂氣氛會持續較長一段時間，中國人把這一段時間總稱為“過年”。
    在現代中國，人們一般認為過年有七天，從除夕到農曆一月六日。
    除夕是農曆十二月三十日，是農曆年的最後一天。這一天，人們要和家人在一起，大家一起包餃子、做年夜飯，一直等到晚上十二點，這是“守歲”。
    “守歲”後，第二天——農曆一月一日到來，就是真正的春節了，是新年的第一天。從這一天開始，人們會去親戚朋友家，一起聊天吃飯，給老人和孩子紅包，這就是“拜年”。“拜年”活動會持續好些天。
    一月五日很特別，很多人會早起放鞭炮。人們認為這一天是窮神離開、金錢之神回來的日子，放鞭炮是為了迎接金錢之神。這種活動叫“破五”。
    一月七日，人們回到公司開始工作，新的一年真正開始了。
    對於學生和不著急出去工作的人來說，他們的春節要更長一些。因為一月七日之後還有一些傳統的小活動，關於吃的、玩兒的，都讓人興奮。一直到過完一月十五日的元宵節，生活才回到老樣子。對於老人來說，真正的春節是從十二月二十三日開始的，二月二日才結束。他們在除夕前打掃房間，等待孩子們回來過年。二月二日春天開始，孩子們回到公司和學校，他們的春節才真正結束。
    所以說，春節並不是只有一天。它到底有多少天，可能每個人的答案都不太一樣。不過呢，不管答案是什麼，都沒有關係，因為開開心心過年才是最重要的呢！

sentences.english: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. People organize many events to celebrate the New Year.
These events and the joy that they bring last for a long period of time, and Chinese people call this period “celebrating New Year”.

sentences.traditional: 從除夕到農曆一月六日。
sentences.pinyin: cóng chú xī dào nóng lì yī yuè liù rì
sentences.english: In modern China, people generally believe that the New Year lasts for seven days, ..
.. from Lunar New Year’s Eve to the sixth day of the first month in the traditional Chinese calendar.

sentences.simplified: 除夕是农历十二月三十日，是农历年的最后一天。
sentences.traditional: 除夕是農曆十二月三十日，是農曆年的最後一天。

sentences.english: Lunar New Year’s Eve is the 30th day of the 12th month in the traditional calendar, the last day of the year in the traditional calendar.

sentences.simplified: 一直等到晚上十二点，这是“守岁”。
sentences.traditional: 一直等到晚上十二點，這是“守歲”。

sentences.english: On this day, people spend time with their families, and everyone wraps dumplings and prepares New Year’s Eve dinner together.
Then they wait up until it’s midnight to see in the New Year. This is called “shousui”.

sentences.simplified: “守岁”后，第二天——农历一月一日到来，就是真正的春节了，是新年的第一天。
sentences.traditional: “守歲”後，第二天——農曆一月一日到來，就是真正的春節了，是新年的第一天。
sentences.pinyin: shǒu suì hòu dì èr tiān nóng lì yī yuè yī rì dào lái jiù shì zhēn zhèng de chūn jié le shì xīn nián de dì yī tiān

sentences.simplified: 从这一天开始，人们会去亲戚朋友家，
sentences.traditional: 從這一天開始，人們會去親戚朋友家，
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè yì tiān kāi shǐ rén men huì qù qīn qi péng you jiā
sentences.english: After seeing in the New Year, the next day—the first day of the lunar calendar—is the real Spring Festival, the first day of the New Year.

sentences.simplified: 一起聊天吃饭，给老人和孩子红包，这就是“拜年”。
sentences.traditional: 一起聊天吃飯，給老人和孩子紅包，這就是“拜年”。
sentences.pinyin: yì qǐ liáo tiān chī fàn gěi lǎo rén hé hái zi hóng bāo zhè jiù shì bài nián
sentences.english: From this day on, people go to the homes of relatives and friends.

sentences.simplified: “拜年”活动会持续好些天。
sentences.traditional: “拜年”活動會持續好些天。
sentences.pinyin: bài nián huó dòng huì chí xù hǎo xiē tiān
sentences.english: They chat and eat together, and give red envelopes to the elderly and children. This is called “bainian”.
Making these New Year visits will last for several days.

sentences.simplified: 一月五日很特别，很多人会早起放鞭炮。
sentences.traditional: 一月五日很特別，很多人會早起放鞭炮。
sentences.pinyin: yī yuè wǔ rì hěn tè bié hěn duō rén huì zǎo qǐ fàng biān pào

sentences.simplified: 人们认为这一天是穷神离开、金钱之神回来的日子，
sentences.traditional: 人們認為這一天是窮神離開、金錢之神回來的日子，
sentences.pinyin: rén men rèn wéi zhè yì tiān shì qióng shén lí kāi jīn qián zhī shén huí lái de rì zi
sentences.english: The fifth day of the first lunar month is very special, and many people will get up early to set off firecrackers.

sentences.simplified: 放鞭炮是为了迎接金钱之神。
sentences.traditional: 放鞭炮是為了迎接金錢之神。
sentences.pinyin: fàng biān pào shì wèi le yíng jiē jīn qián zhī shén
sentences.english: People believe that this is the day when the God of Poverty leaves and the God of Money returns ..

sentences.simplified: 这种活动叫“破五”。
sentences.traditional: 這種活動叫“破五”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng huó dòng jiào pò wǔ
sentences.english: .. and set off firecrackers to welcome the God of Money.
This event is called “Po Wu”.

sentences.simplified: 一月七日，人们回到公司开始工作，新的一年真正开始了。
sentences.traditional: 一月七日，人們回到公司開始工作，新的一年真正開始了。
sentences.pinyin: yī yuè qī rì rén men huí dào gōng sī kāi shǐ gōng zuò xīn de yì nián zhēn zhèng kāi shǐ le

sentences.english: On the seventh day of the first lunar month, people go back to work, and the New Year has really started.

sentences.simplified: 对于学生和不着急出去工作的人来说，他们的春节要更长一些。
sentences.traditional: 對於學生和不著急出去工作的人來說，他們的春節要更長一些。
sentences.pinyin: duì yú xué sheng hé bù zháo jí chū qù gōng zuò de rén lái shuō tā men de chūn jié yào gèng cháng yì xiē

sentences.simplified: 因为一月七日之后还有一些传统的小活动，
sentences.traditional: 因為一月七日之後還有一些傳統的小活動，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi yī yuè qī rì zhī hòu hái yǒu yì xiē chuán tǒng de xiǎo huó dòng
sentences.english: For students and those who are not in a hurry to get back to work, their Spring Festival is a little longer.

sentences.simplified: 关于吃的、玩儿的，都让人兴奋。
sentences.traditional: 關於吃的、玩兒的，都讓人興奮。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú chī de wán'r de dōu ràng rén xīng fèn
sentences.english: Because after the seventh day of the first lunar month, there are some small traditional events ..

sentences.simplified: 一直到过完一月十五日的元宵节，生活才回到老样子。
sentences.traditional: 一直到過完一月十五日的元宵節，生活才回到老樣子。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhí dào guò wán yī yuè shí wǔ rì de yuán xiāo jié shēng huó cái huí dào lǎo yàng zi
sentences.english: .. about food and having fun that people get excited about.

sentences.simplified: 对于老人来说，真正的春节是从十二月二十三日开始的，
sentences.traditional: 對於老人來說，真正的春節是從十二月二十三日開始的，
sentences.pinyin: duì yú lǎo rén lái shuō zhēn zhèng de chūn jié shì cóng shí èr yuè èr shí sān rì kāi shǐ de
sentences.english: It’s not until after the Lantern Festival on the 15th day of the first lunar month that life goes back to normal.

sentences.simplified: 二月二日才结束。
sentences.traditional: 二月二日才結束。
sentences.pinyin: èr yuè èr rì cái jié shù
sentences.english: For old people, the real Spring Festival begins on the 23rd day of the 12th lunar month ..

sentences.simplified: 他们在除夕前打扫房间，等待孩子们回来过年。
sentences.traditional: 他們在除夕前打掃房間，等待孩子們回來過年。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zài chú xī qián dǎ sǎo fáng jiān děng dài hái zi men huí lái guò nián
sentences.english: .. and only ends on the second day of the second lunar month.

sentences.simplified: 二月二日春天开始，孩子们回到公司和学校，
sentences.traditional: 二月二日春天開始，孩子們回到公司和學校，
sentences.pinyin: èr yuè èr rì chūn tiān kāi shǐ hái zi men huí dào gōng sī hé xué xiào
sentences.english: They clean their rooms before New Year’s Eve and wait for their children to return for the celebrations.

sentences.simplified: 他们的春节才真正结束。
sentences.traditional: 他們的春節才真正結束。
sentences.pinyin: tā men de chūn jié cái zhēn zhèng jié shù
sentences.english: Spring begins on the second day of the second month when their children return to work and school.
Their Spring Festival isn’t truly over until then.

sentences.traditional: 所以說，春節並不是只有一天。它到底有多少天，可能每個人的答案都不太一樣。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ shuō chūn jié bìng bú shì zhǐ yǒu yì tiān tā dào dǐ yǒu duō shao tiān kě néng měi ge rén de dá àn dōu bú tài yí yàng

sentences.simplified: 不过呢，不管答案是什么，都没有关系，因为开开心心过年才是最重要的呢！
sentences.traditional: 不過呢，不管答案是什麼，都沒有關係，因為開開心心過年才是最重要的呢！
sentences.pinyin: bú guò ne bù guǎn dá àn shì shén me dōu méi yǒu guān xi yīn wèi kāi kāi xīn xīn guò nián cái shì zuì zhòng yào de ne
sentences.english: So, the Spring Festival is not just one day. The answer to how many days it lasts is probably not quite the same for each person.

sentence_translations: How Many Days Does Spring Festival Last?
If someone asked you what the Spring Festival is, you would probably say that the Spring Festival is the traditional Chinese New Year.
But if they keep asking you the day and the month of the Spring Festival and how many days it lasts in total, ..
.. you will probably have a hard time answering.
The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. People organize many events to celebrate the New Year.
These events and the joy that they bring last for a long period of time, and Chinese people call this period “celebrating New Year”.
In modern China, people generally believe that the New Year lasts for seven days, ..
.. from Lunar New Year’s Eve to the sixth day of the first month in the traditional Chinese calendar.
Lunar New Year’s Eve is the 30th day of the 12th month in the traditional calendar, the last day of the year in the traditional calendar.
On this day, people spend time with their families, and everyone wraps dumplings and prepares New Year’s Eve dinner together.
Then they wait up until it’s midnight to see in the New Year. This is called “shousui”.
After seeing in the New Year, the next day—the first day of the lunar calendar—is the real Spring Festival, the first day of the New Year.
From this day on, people go to the homes of relatives and friends.
They chat and eat together, and give red envelopes to the elderly and children. This is called “bainian”.
Making these New Year visits will last for several days.
The fifth day of the first lunar month is very special, and many people will get up early to set off firecrackers.
People believe that this is the day when the God of Poverty leaves and the God of Money returns ..
.. and set off firecrackers to welcome the God of Money.
This event is called “Po Wu”.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, people go back to work, and the New Year has really started.
For students and those who are not in a hurry to get back to work, their Spring Festival is a little longer.
Because after the seventh day of the first lunar month, there are some small traditional events ..
.. about food and having fun that people get excited about.
It’s not until after the Lantern Festival on the 15th day of the first lunar month that life goes back to normal.
For old people, the real Spring Festival begins on the 23rd day of the 12th lunar month ..
.. and only ends on the second day of the second lunar month.
They clean their rooms before New Year’s Eve and wait for their children to return for the celebrations.
Spring begins on the second day of the second month when their children return to work and school.
Their Spring Festival isn’t truly over until then.
So, the Spring Festival is not just one day. The answer to how many days it lasts is probably not quite the same for each person.
However, no matter what the answer is, it does not matter. Because a happy New Year is what’s most important!
